text.11:41: And he said: Embark therein! In the name of Allah be its course and its mooring. Lo! my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.
text.11:42: And it sailed with them amid waves like mountains, and Noah cried unto his son - and he was standing aloof - O my son! Come ride with us, and be not with the disbelievers.
text.16:8: And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not.
text.18:71: So they twain set out till, when they were in the ship, he made a hole therein. (Moses) said: Hast thou made a hole therein to drown the folk thereof? Thou verily hast done a dreadful thing.
text.29:65: And when they mount upon the ships they pray to Allah, making their faith pure for Him only, but when He bringeth them safe to land, behold! they ascribe partners (unto Him),
text.36:42: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.
text.40:79: Allah it is Who hath appointed for you cattle, that ye may ride on some of them, and eat of some -
text.43:12: He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride.
text.84:19: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
